issue_request: FHIR-25941 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and asked that RegulatedAuthorization.subject support references for regulated authorizations where the authorized subject is a facility or party independent of the product. Jira comments narrowed the missing targets to practitioner (or practitionerRole), organization, and location.
initial_application: Git commit c400edffd62c1c0aba45b6ea5a3821ef58e161e5 explicitly applied FHIR#25941 by adding Practitioner, Organization, and Location to the then-active RegulatedAuthorization spreadsheet subject reference list. The current XML StructureDefinition source was later introduced by 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 with those target profiles preserved.
additional_context: RegulatedAuthorization is active in source/fhir.ini. BRR minutes from 2020-06-16 record FHIR-25941 approval by 11-0-1, matching the Jira vote. Later same-element history, including FHIR-31792 changing RegulatedAuthorization.subject to 0..*, did not remove the FHIR-25941 target profiles. Searches found no later or conflicting evidence requiring PractitionerRole in addition to the applied Practitioner target.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/regulatedauthorization/structuredefinition-RegulatedAuthorization.xml already includes Practitioner, Organization, and Location targetProfile entries on RegulatedAuthorization.subject, and the subject search parameter remains a normal reference search over that element.
